name: week
title: Tutoring week
subtitle: Read-only snapshot. Run npm run view again after changes.

sections.title: Lessons this week
sections.sql: select to_char(l.starts_at,'Dy DD Mon HH24:MI') as starts,sv.name as service,t.name as teacher,lo.name as location,(select string_agg(s.name,', ' order by s.name) from lesson_students ls join students s on s.id=ls.student_id where ls.lesson_id=l.id) as students from lessons l join services sv on sv.id=l.service_id join teachers t on t.id=l.teacher_id join locations lo on lo.id=l.location_id where l.status='scheduled' and l.starts_at>=current_date and l.starts_at<current_date+7 order by l.starts_at

sections.title: Attendance not marked
sections.note: Billing, packages, make-ups and teacher pay all wait on these.
sections.sql: select on_date,to_char(starts_at,'HH24:MI') as at,teacher,service,student from v_roster where attendance is null and lesson_status<>'cancelled' and on_date<current_date order by on_date,teacher

sections.title: Students drifting
sections.sql: select student,family,last_attended,coalesce(next_booked::text,'nothing booked') as next_booked,absences_28d as absences_last_4_weeks from v_student_activity where status='active' and ((next_booked is null and last_attended is not null) or absences_28d>=2) order by last_attended

sections.title: Make-up credits expiring in 14 days
sections.sql: select student,family,expires_on,days_left from v_makeups where state='available' and days_left<=14 order by expires_on

name: money
title: Money in
subtitle: Invoices, packages and what has not been billed yet.

sections.title: Overdue
sections.sql: select family,contact_name,currency,round(overdue_cents/100.0,2) as overdue,oldest_overdue from v_family_balance where overdue_cents>0 order by overdue_cents desc

sections.title: Taught but not billed
sections.sql: select family,count(*) as lessons,currency,round(sum(charge_cents)/100.0,2) as amount,min(on_date) as oldest from v_unbilled group by family,currency order by oldest

sections.title: Packages running low
sections.note: Minutes left against minutes already booked.
sections.sql: select family,student,name,minutes_left,minutes_booked,expires_on from v_package_balance where minutes_left<=60 or minutes_left<minutes_booked order by minutes_left

name: safety
title: Child safety checks
subtitle: Every teacher's checks and every gap found. Not a legal opinion.

sections.title: Findings
sections.sql: select rule,subject as teacher,finding,source from v_compliance where rule not like 'POLICY%' order by rule,subject

sections.title: Checks on file
sections.sql: select t.name as teacher,c.jurisdiction,c.kind,c.number,c.issued_on,c.expires_on,c.verified_on from safety_checks c join teachers t on t.id=c.teacher_id order by t.name
